item.text:
**ResStock excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise apartments.**

| Building type | Included? | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Dormitories | No | Excluded along with prisons and other congregate housing. |
| Assisted care facilities | No | Explicitly excluded under ResStock’s definition of residential housing units. |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes | Includes a multifamily category for buildings with **5+ units and 8+ stories**. |

The exclusions are stated in the [2025 ResStock Technical Reference, Introduction](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf). The high-rise category appears in the [housing characteristics documentation](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/2025_release_1/workflow_inputs/characteristics.html#geometry-building-type-height).

One useful distinction: ResStock models **individual dwelling units** within apartment buildings, rather than each whole building as a single model. [ResStock dataset documentation](https://www.nrel.gov/docs/fy24osti/88109.pdf)
